title: Ways, clusters and cascades
summary: 243 ways by multiplication, cluster pays by BFS, cascades by gravity.

cards.title: 243 ways: multiply, don't enumerate
cards.body: On 5 reels × 3 rows there are 3⁵ = 243 left-to-right paths. Instead of checking each one, count matches per reel and multiply.
A symbol pays once, for its longest run from the left, times the number of ways. The test suite checks this against brute force over all 243 paths.

cards.title: Cluster pays = flood fill
cards.body: "Five or more touching" is a **graph** problem: cells are nodes, equal neighbours are edges. Breadth-first search finds each group.
Mark a cell as seen **when you queue it**, not when you visit it. Otherwise the same cell can be queued many times.

cards.title: Cascades: gravity is two pointers
cards.body: After a win, the winners vanish and each column compacts downward. Then new symbols fall in and the grid is checked again.

cards.question: Reel match counts for a symbol are 2, 1, 3, 0, 2 (5 reels). How many ways does it pay, and for how many reels?
cards.explain: The run stops at reel 4 (0 matches). Reels 1-3 give 2 × 1 × 3 = 6 ways of a 3-reel win. Reel 5 doesn't count: it isn't connected.
